description: Creates a project in the workspace and returns its DSN: the value an app sets as the RUNHEED_DSN environment variable so that runheed.init() reports its errors to this project.

name.description: Project name, usually the app or service name, for example shop-api

slug.description: Optional URL-safe slug; derived from the name when left out

name: runheed_create_project
title: Create a project
